008package paint.getomero.app;
009
010import java.io.File;
011import java.io.IOException;
012import java.nio.file.DirectoryNotEmptyException;
013import java.nio.file.Files;
014import java.nio.file.StandardCopyOption;
015
016/**
017 * Provides functionality to handle and reorganize files stored in directories
018 * starting with the prefix {@code "Fileset"}. Extracts contained files and moves
019 * them into the root directory, then deletes the empty subdirectories.
020 */
021public class ProcessOmeroFiles {
022
023    /**
024     * Processes the specified root directory by identifying and handling subdirectories
025     * whose names start with {@code "Fileset"}. Extracts files from these subdirectories,
026     * moves them into the root directory, and deletes the now-empty folders.
027     *
028     * @param rootDir the root directory to process; must be non-null and a valid directory
029     * @throws IOException if the directory is invalid, no "Fileset" folders exist,
030     *                     or if file operations fail during processing
031     */
032    public static void process(File rootDir) throws IOException {
033        if (rootDir == null || !rootDir.isDirectory()) {
034            throw new IOException("Invalid root directory: " + rootDir);
035        }
036
037        // Collect Fileset* directories
038        File[] filesetDirs = rootDir.listFiles(f -> f.isDirectory() && f.getName().startsWith("Fileset"));
039        if (filesetDirs == null || filesetDirs.length == 0) {
040            throw new IOException("No Fileset directories found in: " + rootDir.getAbsolutePath());
041        }
042
043        // Process each Fileset directory
044        for (File fsDir : filesetDirs) {
045
046            // Move the data files up into the root.
047            File[] files = fsDir.listFiles(f -> f.isFile() && !f.getName().startsWith("."));
048            if (files != null) {
049                for (File f : files) {
050                    Files.move(
051                            f.toPath(),
052                            new File(rootDir, f.getName()).toPath(),
053                            StandardCopyOption.REPLACE_EXISTING
054                    );
055                }
056            }
057
058            // Remove the hidden files the move deliberately skipped — .DS_Store and friends are
059            // operating-system metadata, not data. They also make the folder non-empty, which is
060            // why the delete below used to throw DirectoryNotEmptyException on virtually every
061            // macOS import.
062            File[] hidden = fsDir.listFiles(f -> f.isFile() && f.getName().startsWith("."));
063            if (hidden != null) {
064                for (File h : hidden) {
065                    Files.deleteIfExists(h.toPath());
066                }
067            }
068
069            // The Fileset folder should now be empty. If it is not, something unexpected is in
070            // there (a nested folder, say) — do not delete it blindly, as that would destroy data.
071            // Report it and leave it alone.
072            try {
073                Files.delete(fsDir.toPath());
074            } catch (DirectoryNotEmptyException e) {
075                String[] remaining = fsDir.list();
076                throw new IOException(
077                        "Fileset folder still contains entries after its files were moved, so it "
078                                + "was left in place: " + fsDir.getAbsolutePath()
079                                + " (contains: "
080                                + (remaining == null ? "unreadable" : String.join(", ", remaining))
081                                + ")", e);
082            }
083        }
084    }
085}
